newsitem.title: CHINA: China airport to open eight overseas air routes.
newsitem.headline: China airport to open eight overseas air routes.

text.p: The Sanya Phoenix International Airport in southern China's Hainan province will open eight additional overseas air routes by the end of 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.

A local civil aviation official was quoted as saying the eight air routes will be from Sanya to Hong Kong, Macau and Singapore as well unspecified cities in Germany, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia and Thailand.
Sanya is also expanding its domestic business, opening air routes to Shanghai, Xian and Chengdu, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
